title: Seattle's Best Open Mic @ Skylark Cafe
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring bands and solo acts with professional sound engineering. Full 16-track recordings available for purchase. Features house drums and backline equipment for all performers.
backline: Gretsch house drums - Ampeg Reverb Rocket guitar amp - Yamaha G50410 guitar amp - Ashdown ABM500 bass amp - Keyboard - Shure mics - DIs
event_venue_information:
About Skylark Cafe

Skylark Cafe has established itself as West Seattle's premier music venue and restaurant for over a decade. The intimate space is beloved by musicians and audiences for its exceptional sound quality and excellent sight lines from any seat in the house.

Live Music Programming

Five nights a week the venue books diverse original music spanning indie rock - pop - electronica - Americana - folk - punk - metal - experimental - and jazz. The venue's open mic night has become legendary in Seattle's music community - drawing performers from across the region.

Regular Events

In addition to their famous Wednesday open mic - Skylark hosts Baby Ketten Karaoke on Tuesdays - Alauda Freeform Bellydance on third Tuesdays - weekly trivia nights - and weekend brunch with live music. Under-21 musicians get special spotlight through Mode Music Studios' monthly open mic events.

title: Conor Byrne Open Mic @ Conor Byrne Pub
event_description: Legendary weekly open mic in Ballard's community-owned music venue. All genres welcome in this historic pub dating back to 1901. Sign-ups begin at doors open - music starts at 8 PM in intimate listening room.
event_venue_information:
About Conor Byrne Pub

Conor Byrne Cooperative represents Ballard's first community-owned music venue with over 600 member-owners. The historic building dates to 1901 when it opened as The Owl Saloon - making it one of Seattle's oldest operating music venues.

Music Programming

The cooperative showcases diverse live music seven nights a week - from their legendary Sunday open mic to country dance nights - Irish music sessions - matinee shows - and ticketed concerts. The venue has become a cornerstone of Seattle's independent music scene.

Community Ownership

Formed in May 2024 - the cooperative model ensures the venue's long-term sustainability while preserving its cultural significance. Members receive drink specials - event access - and voting rights at annual meetings. The venue offers ADA accessibility and maintains a welcoming atmosphere for all ages at select events.

title: Jazz/Blues Jam @ Kenyon Hall
event_description: Monthly Final Friday jam sessions led by emerging student musicians and young professionals. House trio from Chief Sealth music program provides backing. Open to all instruments and vocalists with dedicated theme song lists each month.
backline: House trio provided - all instruments welcome
event_venue_information:
About Kenyon Hall

Kenyon Hall sits atop High Point in West Seattle - offering an intimate listening space with a modest stage welcoming all ages - genres - and skill levels. The venue has become a community hub for music education and performance.

Jazz and Blues Programming

The Final Friday Jazz/Blues Jam series focuses on helping learning and early professional players develop improvisational skills. Each session features a house trio that supports soloists - duos - and trios who sign up to perform. Monthly themed set-lists help musicians prepare while encouraging them to bring their own material.

Educational Mission

Kenyon Hall prioritizes creating safe learning environments where musicians can develop their craft alongside peers. All admission is free - ensuring accessibility for emerging artists. The venue also hosts various other community music events throughout the year.

title: All Ages Jam Session @ Black and Tan Hall
event_description: Monthly old-school jazz jam hosted by award-winning drummer D'Vonne Lewis. Open to all levels and ages of jazz players. Part of Seattle Jazz Fellowship's community programming in historic Hillman City venue.
event_venue_information:
About Black and Tan Hall

Black and Tan Hall operates as a values-driven cultural hub sustaining a thriving equitable economy through arts and cultural programming in Hillman City. The historic venue honors Seattle's jazz legacy while creating space for contemporary expression.

Seattle Jazz Fellowship Events

The All Ages Jam Session represents Seattle Jazz Fellowship's commitment to nurturing next-generation jazz talent. D'Vonne Lewis - an award-winning drummer - creates an old-school atmosphere where players of any skill level can participate. The sessions prioritize learning - collaboration - and musical growth.

Full-Service Experience

On jam session Sundays - the Hall serves brunch from 10 AM to 2 PM - then reopens at 3:30 PM with a full bar and food menu. No cover charge ensures accessibility while the venue's supportive atmosphere encourages risk-taking and artistic development. Reservations available for dining.
